emma (product): short thread: sales asked for clear export SLA + key metadata guarantees for enterprise legal holds. can we agree on minimal manifest fields and rollout plan?

raj (eng): suggest minimal manifest: legal_hold_id, tenant_id, requested_by, time_range, object_list (path+sha256), kms_key_id (if BYOK), signing_key_id. simple example inline: `{"legal_hold_id":"lh_123","tenant_id":"t_1","objects":[{"path":"s3://...","sha256":"abc"}]}`

tara (security): require HSM-signed manifest or customer-supplied verification key for BYOK. manifest must include signing_key_fingerprint and signing_ts. acceptance: security must validate 3 signed manifests (one BYOK + customer key, one BYOK without escrow, one standard) during canary.

ana (legal): legal needs two SLAs: targeted export ready within 48h, full scoped export within 10 days. also need API to pin records (indefinite retention) and an audit trail with requester_email and custody_ticket. include `legal_hold.reason_code`.

sam (ops): ops concerns: exports spike egress. propose export queue with per-tenant rate limit and `exports.priority` flag. canary: 4 tenants for 72h -> 20% traffic for 5 days -> full. will add dashboard for "pending legal exports" and quota alerts.

emma (product): decision list by Fri: (1) manifest fields, (2) export SLAs, (3) key retention window (we propose 3 years of key metadata), (4) canary cadence.

raj (eng): migration note: we won't backfill old archives. for legacy exports we generate on-demand manifests (best-effort). new exports emit manifest_v1 alongside bundles. feature-flag `exports.legalhold_v1` for rollout.

tara (security): also require checksum per object and a signed manifest inside the archive (tamper-evidence). record signing_audit_id to trace signing operations.

ana (legal): legal confirms acceptance criteria: sample manifest must surface requester, issued_at, reason_code, and a link to archive object paths.

ci-bot: created ticket INF-3301 and scheduled a canary window placeholder.

emma (product): thanks all  I'll draft RFC and post link. send any objections by EOD Thu.
